_agi_canonical.title: The Protocol Economics Puzzle
_agi_canonical.bar: strictly harder than L10 anchors; >=3 AGI properties; strategy not disclosed in prompt
_agi_canonical.derivation: If the cut passes, sell pressure falls by 16k/day for three days and 20k/day for nine days versus the current 30k/day baseline, for 228k fewer YLD sold. At $2.40 this is $547.2k less sell pressure, plus the $40k stabilization order. With a 0.35 impact coefficient against $800k DEX liquidity, expected 12-day price change is (587.2k/800k)*0.35 = 25.69%. Positive reflexivity above 10% supports vote yes and stay.
_agi_canonical.pass_condition: All required strategy fields must match and all numeric fields must fall inside tolerance/range.
